1.title: Trump says ceasefire is 'over' after US and Iran trade strikes
1.summary: Speaking ahead of a Nato summit, the president says US negotiators can keep talking with the Iranians "if they want".

2.title: The Low-Key Lawyer at the Center of the Search for a Platner Replacement
2.summary: Charles Dingman, chair of the Maine Democratic Party and a progressive, would play a key role in choosing the state’s Democratic Senate candidate if Graham Platner leaves the race.

3.title: A Conservative Role Model for Ending the Fertility Crisis
3.summary: Emma Waters, pregnant with her third child, is crafting policy to encourage early parenthood. Some think she is pushing an ideology that does not meet reality.

4.title: Iran Live Updates: Trump Casts Doubt on Future of Cease-Fire After Latest Strikes
4.summary: “I think it’s over,” President Trump said, referring to the preliminary truce. Iran’s armed forces earlier said they had targeted U.S. military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait in response to the latest U.S. attacks.

5.title: The Alluring Albanian Island Inspiring Ivanka’s Fantasy
5.summary: A former military base in the Adriatic Sea, the island is in a beautiful setting but it is strewed with snakes, crumbling buildings and land mines.

6.title: Live Updates: Trump Lashes Out at Europe at NATO Summit
6.summary: President Trump assailed allies for not joining the war in Iran, called Spain “hopeless” and repeated his desire to control Greenland. His criticism cast a pall over a meeting critical for NATO’s future.
